name: Pondhead · Gremlet #46
description:
A squat old machine with a dent in its head that filled with rain. A lily pad and a little flower live there now.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Pondhead in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
